title: Mobile Suit Gundam Side Story: Optional Guide
native_title: 機動戦士ガンダム外伝 －ＯＰＴＩＯＮＡＬ ＧＵＩＤＥ－
overview:
Optional Guide is the bonus data disc packed with Mobile Suit Gundam Side Story: The Blue Destiny, the set that collects all three chapters of the Gundam Side Story 3D shooting series. Those games put you in the cockpit of an Earth Federation mobile suit during the One Year War, in a story built around the blue mobile suit fitted with the EXAM System.

The guide disc is a collection of extras rather than a game:
- Illustrations and newly drawn image CG
- Strategy movies for the games
- Commercials and merchandise released alongside the series
- A short skit by Maurin and Philip that plays as a warning when the disc is put in an audio CD player
